data.name: Ejaaz
data.long_meaning: The name Ejaaz means 'granted, permission'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ajz', which means 'to forbid, prevent'. The name signifies that whatever is being sought or desired has been granted or permitted. This name is often given to a child as a sign of hope and optimism that they will be granted success and freedom in their future endeavors.

It is a reminder of the infinite mercy and generosity of Allah, and a source of comfort and inspiration for those who bear the name. It is also a reminder of the importance of seeking permission and guidance from Allah in all matters.
